short_description:
Who Should Use It?

This scrub is suitable for all skin types, especially dry or textured skin that needs a little extra love. It’s a great choice if:

  • You’re looking for a natural glow.

  • You deal with dry, flaky skin.

  • You want to improve skin texture and smoothness.

  • You’re aiming to level up your self-care routine.

How to Use:

  1. In the shower or bath, apply a generous amount of the scrub to damp skin.

  2. Gently massage in circular motions to exfoliate.

  3. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry.

  4. Follow with your favorite body oil or moisturizer to lock in hydration.

Use 2-3 times a week for best results.

Pro Tips 🌟

  • Use before shaving for a smoother shave and to help reduce ingrown hairs.

  • For an at-home spa day, follow it with a body lotion from Dr Teals collection.

  • Apply before a self-tanner for a more even application.
description:
DR TEALS Shea Sugar Scrub 538g – Citrus & Vitamin C | BuyBetter Nigeria

Say hello to smooth, radiant skin with the Dr Teals Shea Sugar Scrub with Vitamin C — a body care must-have that combines gentle exfoliation with intense hydration. Whether you’re starting your day with an energizing scrub or winding down at night, this scrub delivers a spa-like experience that reveals healthy, glowing skin with every use.

This isn’t just any sugar scrub — it’s powered by pure sugar crystals, shea butter, Vitamin C, and essential oils, making it your ultimate self-care companion.

Why You’ll Love It ❤️

1. Exfoliates Gently, But Effectively:
The sugar granules in Dr Teals scrub are the perfect texture for sloughing off dead skin cells without being too harsh or abrasive. It buffs away dry, dull skin to reveal a softer, smoother surface instantly. Whether you’re dealing with rough elbows, knees, or just want that full-body glow, this scrub delivers.

2. Boosts Natural Radiance with Vitamin C:
Vitamin C is known as a powerhouse antioxidant—and for good reason! It brightens dull skin, helps even out skin tone, and supports collagen production for firmer, more youthful-looking skin. In this scrub, Vitamin C works to give your body the same glow you crave in your facial skincare.

3. Deeply Moisturizing Shea Butter:
Enriched with ultra-nourishing shea butter, this scrub doesn’t just exfoliate—it deeply conditions your skin too. It’s perfect for those who want to exfoliate without stripping away essential moisture. After rinsing, your skin is left feeling soft, supple, and hydrated—not tight or dry.

4. Aromatherapy in a Jar:
Infused with uplifting citrus essential oils, every scrub session feels like a mood-boosting escape. The scent is refreshing, clean, and energizing—ideal for a morning pick-me-up or post-workout reset.

Who Should Use It?

This scrub is suitable for all skin types, especially dry or textured skin that needs a little extra love. It’s a great choice if:

  • You’re looking for a natural glow.

  • You deal with dry, flaky skin.

  • You want to improve skin texture and smoothness.

  • You’re aiming to level up your self-care routine.

How to Use:

  1. In the shower or bath, apply a generous amount of the scrub to damp skin.

  2. Gently massage in circular motions to exfoliate.

  3. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry.

  4. Follow with your favorite body oil or moisturizer to lock in hydration.

Use 2-3 times a week for best results.

Pro Tips 🌟

  • Use before shaving for a smoother shave and to help reduce ingrown hairs.

  • For an at-home spa day, follow it with a body lotion from Dr Teals collection.

  • Apply before a self-tanner for a more even application.

Clean Beauty, Trusted Ingredients:

Dr Teal’s products are made with clean, skin-loving ingredients and are free from parabens, phthalates, and sulfates. It’s a product you can feel good about using regularly on your skin.

Final Verdict

The Dr Teal’s Shea Sugar Scrub with Vitamin C is more than just a body scrub—it’s a self-care ritual in a jar. From its gentle exfoliating power to its skin-brightening benefits and delicious scent, it’s everything you want in a body scrub and more. Whether you’re gifting it to a friend or treating yourself, one thing’s for sure: your skin will thank you.
